_why: 3.6 step 4: an enemy casts Bane at the player's side: the player and the archer ally each make a Charisma save (DC 25 here, so both fail) and are Baned for 10 rounds; the caster concentrates on it (3.9). The hedge-mage fights with Poison Spray from Close and the archer stands far back out of its reach, so the player is its target and it casts Bane on its turn. The menu shows the Baned line, and the archer's next attack roll loses a d4.
